front.title: Traffic Steering using BGP FlowSpec with SR Policy

abstract.t: BGP Flow Specification (FlowSpec) provides mechanisms to distribute traffic filtering and steering rules across BGP networks. This document specifies BGP FlowSpec procedures to steer matching traffic flows into Segment Routing (SR) Policies. It defines two modes of operation: transport steering into an SR Policy ("Mode 1"), in SR- MPLS and SRv6 networks, using BGP Extended Communities; and, in SRv6 networks, transport steering combined with an egress service action at the egress node ("Mode 2"), signaled with the BGP Prefix-SID Attribute.
